component_en: Rolling bearings (NU1024 x2, QJ1024, NU2209 x2, NU2210 x2, QJ209, QJ210, 6305 x2, 6202 x2, 6203 x2) and the planet roller sets
component_tr: Rulmanlar (NU1024 x2, QJ1024, NU2209 x2, NU2210 x2, QJ209, QJ210, 6305 x2, 6202 x2, 6203 x2) ve planet makara setleri
key_values: aerospace grade, M50 VIM-VAR (AMS 6491) rings and rolling elements, M50NiL (AMS 6278) for the propeller bearings (hoop stress of the fits); silver-plated machined cages; the internal geometry of step 2.5; planet set speed limit at least 6,020 rpm at 110% (ICD)

component_en: Carbon face seals: propeller shaft, input, generator pad
component_tr: Karbon yüz contaları: pervane mili, giriş, jeneratör pedi
key_values: mating ring with a hard coating (tungsten carbide, HVOF, TBR); dust excluder lip on the propeller seal (ENV-03); leakage at most 2 cm3/h (TBR)
low-temperature fluorocarbon (AMS 7287 type, -40 degC with MIL-PRF-23699), AS568 sizes

component_en: Magnetic chip detectors (2) with self-closing valves and electrical indication
component_tr: Kendinden kapanan valfli ve elektrik uyarılı manyetik talaş dedektörleri (2)
key_values: in the planetary and first-stage sumps, reachable without removing the RGB

component_en: Speed pickups: Np x2 on the input pinion (control and cross-check), Nr x2 on the propeller shaft P103 at z 400 (TBR), with two phonic wheels; the protection Np is the core PT-rotor signal (ICD-36)
component_tr: Hız algılayıcılar: giriş pinyonunda Np x2 (kontrol ve çapraz kontrol), pervane mili P103 üzerinde z 400'de Nr x2 (TBR), iki dişli tekerle; koruma Np'si çekirdeğin PT rotoru sinyali (ICD-36)
key_values: variable reluctance; separate connectors and harness routes for the control and protection channels; control and protection read different phonic wheels; phonic wheels in 4340 (TBR); qualified with the harness for EMI and lightning (14 CFR 33.28(b)(2))

component_en: Condition monitoring: accelerometers A1-A3, inline oil debris monitor, oil pressure and temperature, filter differential pressure, the PT-shaft tunnel air temperature sensor (step 2.2)
component_tr: Durum izleme: A1-A3 ivmeölçerleri, hat içi yağ talaş izleyicisi, yağ basıncı ve sıcaklığı, filtre fark basıncı, PT mili tüneli hava sıcaklığı algılayıcısı (adım 2.2)
key_values: positions of step 2.10; tunnel sensor of step 2.2

component_en: Thermostatic valve at the RGB inlet
key_values: modulating (wax element), starts to open at 60 degC and full flow through the cooler by about 70 degC (band TBR); it sets the inlet on cold days (about 60 degC at -20 and -40 degC ambient at maximum continuous power); the 3.2 model treats it as on/off, so a valve with a stated band is required; fails to the cooler-open position

component_en: Oil filter 3 um with bypass valve (170 kPa) and impending-bypass indication (120 kPa)
component_tr: 3 um yağ filtresi, baypas valfi (170 kPa) ve tıkanma öncesi uyarısı (120 kPa)
key_values: clean drop 35 kPa at 30 L/min, 100 degC (step 3.2)

component_en: Pressure regulating valve (550 kPa) and pump relief valve (1100 kPa)
component_tr: Basınç ayar valfi (550 kPa) ve pompa emniyet valfi (1100 kPa)

component_en: Low-oil-pressure switch: opens the mist valve and sends the 75% MCP limit to the FADEC
component_tr: Düşük yağ basıncı anahtarı: sis valfini açar ve FADEC'e %75 MCP sınırını gönderir

key_values: opened by the C-10 switch; bleed air 10-20 SCFM at <= 100 degC
170 fasteners in 12 joints, 1.31 kg bottom-up (A286; 1.96 kg with x1.5) against the 5.21 kg allowance; self-locking helical coil inserts (NASM21209) in the castings; lockwire or self-locking nuts

component_en: Steel seat liners for the bearing outer rings in the castings
component_tr: Dökümlerde rulman dış bilezikleri için çelik yuva gömlekleri
key_values: 13 liners, +1.28 kg not in the roll-up; the shrink fit loosens by 0.19 mm (NU1024 liner) from 20 to 132 degC and tightens by 0.10 mm at -40 degC: fit and hoop stress in 3.5
PTFE hose with CRES braid and fire sleeve, fire resistant (AS1055)
fireproof by construction (CRES or titanium sheet) or by a fire blanket; 6.8 L
